reasons: The syllabus states the same rule: individuals may not be held personally liable under a Spending Clause statute unless they voluntarily and knowingly consented to answer lawsuits under it.
The majority states that Mr. Landor did not allege any individual entered an agreement with the federal government and that he has no federal RLUIPA cause of action against the officers.
residual_risks: The statement should not be read to decide whether RLUIPA ever authorizes damages against a consenting funding recipient; the Court expressly avoided that broader statutory question.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: For maximum fidelity, say Landor did not allege that any officer entered an agreement with the federal government, rather than phrasing that point only as an affirmative historical fact.
